versions.changelog:
- Added new directories: references and scripts, to organize supporting materials and executable files.
- Removed skill-card.md file.
- No changes to user-facing features or documentation content.

- Initial release of the child-screen-time skill.
- Standalone command-line tool to set, track, and negotiate screen time contracts for children.
- Supports daily limits for entertainment and educational screen time, with bonus time for positive behaviors.
- Logs usage, awards, deductions, and generates weekly compliance report cards.
- Includes a negotiation system for additional screen time requests.
- All data stored locally in a user-accessible file.
